description: This file defines the Currency class for managing currency data, including conversion, retrieval, and display functionalities within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM system. It encapsulates operations such as currency conversion to and from USD, retrieving default currency settings, and generating currency-related HTML components.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Represents a currency entity with methods for conversion, retrieval, formatting, and display within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM framework.

methods.name: convertToDollar
methods.description: Converts a specified currency amount to USD using the conversion rate.

methods.name: convertFromDollar
methods.description: Converts a USD amount to the specified currency using the conversion rate.

methods.name: getDefaultCurrencyName
methods.description: Retrieves the default currency name from system configuration.

methods.name: getDefaultCurrencySymbol
methods.description: Retrieves the default currency symbol from system configuration.

methods.name: getDefaultISO4217
methods.description: Retrieves the default ISO 4217 currency code.

methods.name: retrieveIDBySymbol
methods.description: Fetches the ID of a currency based on its symbol if not marked as deleted.

methods.name: retrieve_id_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves the currency ID given its name.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Loads a currency record by ID or initializes default values if given ID is -99.

methods.name: getPdfCurrencySymbol
methods.description: Returns the currency symbol for PDF display, replacing it with a special character for the Euro.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares list view data with formatted conversion rate.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the currency object and clears cache.
